svg.title: Lung ultrasound coverage map
svg.desc: Unrolled map of one hemithorax showing upper and lower anterior, lateral, and posterior regions. Repeat on the other side. Anterior and lateral regions comprise the eight-zone bilateral B-line survey; posterior regions extend coverage. BLUE and PLAPS landmarks are summarized below.
svg.text: Scan both sides · record the regions you actually obtain
One hemithorax, unrolled from sternum to spine. Repeat the same map on the other side.
Use a consistent upper/lower boundary and confirm the diaphragm at the lung base.
Rapid BLUE points are starting sites, not complete coverage
Upper: roots of middle/ring fingers of the upper BLUE hand, just beneath the clavicle.
Lower: center of the lower palm. Hands are stacked, fingertips toward the sternum.
PLAPS: at the lower-point level, as posterior as accessible around the posterior axillary line.
Schematic coverage map · mark inaccessible regions as “not assessed” · document sampled interspaces for trends
